High Protein Pasta Bake
Total Time: 45 min
Servings: 6–8

Ingredients:
• 16 oz penne pasta
• 1 lb 90% lean ground beef
• 24 oz marinara sauce
• 1 cup part-skim ricotta
• 2 cups shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese
• 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
• 1 tsp Italian seasoning

Instructions:
Cook the penne pasta until al dente and drain.
Brown the ground beef in a large skillet; drain the fat and stir in the marinara sauce and Italian seasoning.
Mix the pasta with the meat sauce and ricotta and spread in a 9x13 baking dish.
Top with the mozzarella cheese and parmesan cheese and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes.
